parts.content: In `builder.py`: any path with a `.git` component at any depth is not part of the checkout, refused by every tool as `not part of the checkout` and left out of listings, as `.git` at the root already is. `numbers.json` carries `written` and `edited`, the paths the tools wrote and edited in order, so the record names every file the run touched whatever git lists, and the numbers line carries them too. The diffs of `record_diff` run with `--text` as well, so an attribute cannot turn the patch into a binary notice. `git_env()` sets `LC_ALL` to `C`, so git answers in English, and the not-a-checkout test reads the first line of git's stderr after `fatal: ` and nothing else. The refusal the model reads for a protected path says `protected: <path> (not the builder's to change: the tests, the toolchain, the vault and git's own files)`. The tests in `test_builder.py` whose docstring names this seed define the behaviour; `check.Dockerfile`'s comments say checkout, by the attended agent.

554	def record_diff(checkout: Path, run_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
555	    """What the run left in the checkout: diff.patch (absent when the run left nothing), and the
556	    three numbers about it."""
557	    # -z so a path with a space or a quote survives; -uall so a new directory is listed as files.
558	    status = git(checkout, "status", "--porcelain", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
559	    untracked = [entry[3:] for entry in status.split("\0") if entry.startswith("?? ")]
560	    # Against HEAD, so a change the run staged is in the patch too; the checkout is always a git
561	    # checkout with a commit, so there is always a HEAD. A run that left nothing leaves no patch.
562	    # --no-ext-diff and --no-textconv keep the patch git's own: neither the environment, nor the
563	    # configuration, nor a .gitattributes in the checkout can replace it with a program's output.
564	    # Every diff ends its options with --, so a file the run names -x.txt or HEAD is a path to git
565	    # and not an option or a revision.
566	    flags = ("--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv")
567	    parts = [git(checkout, "diff", *flags, "HEAD", "--")]
568	    for rel in untracked:
569	        parts.append(git(checkout, "diff", *flags, "--no-index", "--", "/dev/null", rel, ok=(0, 1)))
570	    patch = "".join(parts)
571	    if patch:
572	        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(patch)  # the patch first: counting can fail
573	    files = insertions = deletions = 0
574	    for line in git(checkout, "diff", "HEAD", "--numstat", "--").splitlines():
575	        added, removed, _path = line.split("\t", 2)
576	        files += 1
577	        insertions += int(added) if added.isdigit() else 0  # "-" for a binary file
578	        deletions += int(removed) if removed.isdigit() else 0
579	    for rel in untracked:
580	        files += 1
581	        p = checkout / rel  # a broken symlink or a nested checkout has no lines to count
582	        insertions += len(p.read_bytes().splitlines()) if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() else 0
